diagnostics.message:
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
`module.aws_eks_teams` creates Kubernetes namespaces, RBAC objects, service accounts, and `kubectl_manifest` resources, but it does not wait for the `kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` readiness/auth barrier that the other Kubernetes-facing modules use. It should depend on `kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` so the cluster API is ready and aws-auth is configured before team Kubernetes resources are applied.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
The aws_eks_teams module creates Kubernetes namespaces, RBAC resources, and manifests but has no ordering dependency on the aws-auth ConfigMap or cluster readiness. Its Kubernetes resources can race with cluster/API readiness; add depends_on = [kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth] so they are created only after read-readiness and aws-auth are applied.
